question: In a code language, ‘PURE’ is written as ‘NSPC’ and ‘WHITE’ is written as ‘UFGRC’. How will ‘COLOUR’ be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9e82b7da6e41b2a069e2db44b7b686c69a4d8afae6d389dc05a659aaeaa56953.png] 

According to english alphabet positional value

The pattern followed here is :

‘PURE’ is written as ‘NSPC’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ec150ddeceffd3396006b6c11d08c001c77dde11b2e54479eaa4f895218e2f79.png] 

And,

‘WHITE’ is written as ‘UFGRC’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/004230c40c5c1116e8b283f5f8e186ec3a40fe20f8bacadc482aed70180ad079.png] 

Similarly,

COLOUR is written as AMJMSP

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3ceca9ac6672ebcd146252a1465712cdbb1d36f81351640f3bc0b5cbbc7957a8.png] 

Hence, **"Option 1" i**s the correct answer.
